description: New Sales mail agent was also switched on in the Founder mail account's Used by list, and Only this agent is off, so Sales mail stays readable by all 8 other bots.
expected: A dedicated agent for one account has access only to that account; the exclusive default matches Carta's (on).
actual: Used by (Founder mail) shows 'Sales mail agent' on; Only this agent is off for the Sales row.
suggested_fix: Do not add the new agent to other accounts' access; consider defaulting Only this agent on, as Carta does.

description: Create agent lands on a blank chat: no greeting, no hint that the agent is read-only, no link back to the app page.
expected: A first message or pointer (as the Carta agent chat has) that says what the agent can do.
actual: Empty thread titled 'Sales mail agent' with only the composer.
suggested_fix: Show a short intro or suggested prompts for connected-app agents.

description: At 390px the account row buttons wrap unevenly: Founder row has Rename on the title line and Create agent / Remove account below; Sales row has Rename on the title line and Remove account alone.
expected: Buttons stay in one consistent group.
suggested_fix: Stack the row actions in one wrapped group under the name.

description: Creating an agent moves Used by from a page-level list into the first account row, which pushes the Sales row's Agent card to y=741+ of an 800px viewport; the page needed 1500px to see it.
expected: Agent controls for the account just acted on stay visible.
actual: Agent card below the fold at 1280x800 (step-4 shows only the Sales row heading).
suggested_fix: Collapse Used by per account, or show it only on demand.

description: The hint copy repeats the account name three times: 'Allow changes in Sales mail', 'Other agents ask the Sales mail agent instead of using Sales mail themselves.'
expected: Shorter wording, e.g. 'Other agents ask this agent instead.'
actual: Account name x3 plus agent name inside one card under a row already titled Sales mail.
suggested_fix: Use 'this account' / 'this agent' inside the account row.
